editor_note: All six rewritten entries are faithful and read naturally: the bounds caveat ("întreagă, cu o limită inferioară și una superioară explicite", error 4710), "Modificări incompatibile" for breaking changes, the value mapping "off"->0 through "strong"->3 with the default left unchanged at 3, and "job Qiskit Runtime", which keeps the house-style name in English.

The rewritten caption in entry 28 is accurate. It keeps that QPU time is "minim și aproape constant" because only one QAOA round ("o singură rundă de QAOA") is used, with optimal parameters obtained on a CPU, so the meaning has not drifted. The one slip is casing: the caption writes "problemei market split" in lowercase, while the rest of the Romanian page (entries 24, 25, 29, 31 area, 58, 62) consistently writes "Market Split". It should be capitalized to match.

examples.source: Performance metrics for different instances of the market split problem.
examples.translation: Metrici de performanță pentru diferite instanțe ale problemei market split.
examples.suggested: Metrici de performanță pentru diferite instanțe ale problemei Market Split.
examples.why: Everywhere else on the Romanian page the problem name is capitalized as "Market Split" (e.g. entries 24, 25, 29). The lowercase form in the caption breaks that convention within the file. It is a cosmetic issue and does not mislead.

editor_note: The three rewritten entries (40, 41, 44) keep their meaning. The ibm_miami figures (below 10% at width 9 / 10 qubits, Orbit near 80–90%), the ibm_kingston figures (about 15% near width 60) and the calibration caveat all come through accurately. In entry 44, "reports shot counts" became "raportează numărul de shot-uri", which reads as the total number of shots rather than the per-outcome counts histogram; entry 51 already uses "numărătorile" for this. Entry 41 capitalizes "Backend-ului", while the rest of the page writes "backend-ul" / "backend-ului" in lowercase.

examples.source: the executable example below reports shot counts for one fixed hidden-bitstring width
examples.translation: exemplul executabil de mai jos raportează numărul de shot-uri pentru o singură lățime fixă
examples.suggested: exemplul executabil de mai jos raportează numărătorile (counts) obținute pentru o singură lățime fixă
examples.why: 'numărul de shot-uri' suggests the total number of shots run, not the per-bitstring counts histogram the example prints. Entry 51 already uses 'numărătorile' for this.

examples.source: Exact results depend on the backend calibration, circuit, and execution settings.
examples.translation: Rezultatele exacte depind de calibrarea Backend-ului, de circuit și de setările de execuție.
examples.suggested: Rezultatele exacte depind de calibrarea backend-ului, de circuit și de setările de execuție.
examples.why: The rest of the file writes 'backend-ul' in lowercase (entries 9, 11, 48, 58, 65). The capitalized form here is inconsistent.

editor_note: Both rewritten entries are faithful: [72] keeps the right CNOT direction ("cu Q ca element de control și propriul qubit ca țintă", followed by "un gate Hadamard pe Q") and matches the "gate"/"entanglează" wording already used in [64]; [73] keeps the math exactly as in the English and renders the grouping sentence correctly ("să grupăm termenii ... în funcție de rezultatele măsurătorilor pe qubiții A și Q").

All three rewritten entries (53, 78, 87) keep the English meaning, and none would mislead a learner. Entry 53 has the reproducibility condition with `seed_transpiler` right, entry 78 keeps "degenerate optima", first-solution-only and the variable_mapping character position, and entry 87 keeps the options list and its purpose. The one thing to change is in entry 78. "adresată după numele variabilei" copies the English "addressed" too literally, and a Romanian technical writer would say "accesată după numele variabilei".

examples.source: Only the first solution is considered here, addressed by variable name.
examples.translation: Aici este luată în considerare doar prima soluție, adresată după numele variabilei.
examples.suggested: Aici este luată în considerare doar prima soluție, accesată după numele variabilelor.
examples.why: 'adresată' is a literal copy of 'addressed'. In Romanian, data is 'accessed' (accesată) or 'indexed' (indexată) by name, so 'accesată' reads more naturally.

editor_note: Entry 60 is accurate and would not mislead a learner. "Evaluează fidelitatea procesului QFT cu Orbit" is a fair rendering of "Benchmark", and Orbit and Quantum Elements stay in English. The one defect is that "a Qiskit Function" became the generic "o funcție Qiskit". House style keeps the Qiskit Functions product name in English, and entries 53-57 on this page do that ("Qiskit Functions de la Q-CTRL"). The phrase should read "o Qiskit Function de la Quantum Elements".

examples.source: Benchmark QFT process fidelity with Orbit, a Qiskit Function by Quantum Elements
examples.translation: Evaluează fidelitatea procesului QFT cu Orbit, o funcție Qiskit de la Quantum Elements
examples.suggested: Evaluează fidelitatea procesului QFT cu Orbit, o Qiskit Function de la Quantum Elements
examples.why: Qiskit Function(s) is a product name that stays in English (ALWAYS_ENGLISH_NAMES). The rest of the page keeps it in English (entries 53, 54, 57), so the translated singular is inconsistent with house style.

editor_note: Entry 12 says the same thing as the English. The couplings are randomly distributed between positive and negative values, the triangular-arrangement example is kept, and "compounded globally" becomes "amplificată global", so a learner would not be misled. The one thing a native editor would change is "fiecare spin interacționează cu fiecare alt spin". That copies the English "every other spin" word for word; idiomatic Romanian is "cu toți ceilalți spini". "Constrângeri conflictuale" is acceptable, though "constrângeri contradictorii" reads a little more naturally.

examples.line_approx: În modelul SK, deoarece fiecare spin interacționează cu fiecare alt spin
examples.source: because every spin interacts with every other spin
examples.translation: deoarece fiecare spin interacționează cu fiecare alt spin
examples.suggested: deoarece fiecare spin interacționează cu toți ceilalți spini
examples.why: "Fiecare alt spin" copies the English "every other" word for word. A Romanian physics writer would write "toți ceilalți spini". The meaning is unchanged, so this is a minor issue.

editor_note: None of the 23 rewritten entries changes the meaning. The O(n^2) vs O(n) argument in [17], the partitioning caveats in [5]/[32]/[49] and the MEM-adjusted vs unmitigated counts in [51] all match the English. The remaining problems are polish. "child job" is left in English in [5] ("trei joburi Runtime Batch child", "child job") and [11], but the other entries say "job copil" ([4], [32], [49], [51]). "Layout" is "configurațiile" in [33] but "dispunere" everywhere else. [67] sends the reader to "secțiunea Setup", but that heading is rendered "Configurare". [35] ("echivalentul său semiclasic dinamic QFT") and [48] ("în interiorul Function") have awkward, calqued word order.

examples.source: partitioning circuit sizes across three Runtime Batch child jobs [...] Each fixed-size comparison remains in one child job
examples.translation: între trei joburi Runtime Batch child [...] rămâne într-un singur child job
examples.suggested: între trei joburi copil Runtime Batch [...] rămâne într-un singur job copil
examples.why: Mixes English 'child' into Romanian word order, and is inconsistent with 'job copil' in [4], [32], [49] and [51]. [11] has the same 'child job'.

examples.source: preserve the explicitly selected dynamic-circuit layouts
examples.translation: a păstra configurațiile de circuite dinamice alese explicit
examples.suggested: a păstra dispunerile alese explicit pentru circuitele dinamice
examples.why: 'Layout' is 'dispunere' everywhere else in the file ([39], [42], [56], [67]). Here 'configurații' hides that this is the same qubit layout.

examples.source: all of which are defined in the Setup section near the top
examples.translation: toate acestea fiind definite în secțiunea Setup din apropierea începutului
examples.suggested: toate acestea fiind definite în secțiunea Configurare de la începutul paginii
examples.why: The section heading is rendered 'Configurare' ([29]), so the reader will not find a section called 'Setup'. 'din apropierea începutului' also sounds stiff.

examples.source: either the standard unitary QFT or its semiclassical dynamic QFT equivalent
examples.translation: fie QFT unitar standard, fie echivalentul său semiclasic dinamic QFT
examples.suggested: fie QFT-ul unitar standard, fie echivalentul său dinamic semiclasic
examples.why: Calqued English word order with a trailing, redundant 'QFT'.

examples.source: Orbit creates the authenticated Runtime Batch inside the Function
examples.translation: Orbit creează Runtime Batch-ul autentificat în interiorul Function
examples.suggested: Orbit creează Runtime Batch-ul autentificat în interiorul funcției
